items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: the our band, Earl Crumb, and Monk Smith, Benji White, you know, Jelpy, all of them had bands... He was a musician, see? Had a band, and you got him playing in the band with him

ctx.x: Yeah. I know the place, and I've talked to him on the phone, but he says he hasn't lived in the past. Well, he's kind of, I believe. Please. Well, it's all right. Okay. Well, he, yeah, he told me about McCoskey was in the band, and maybe Jack Asano. Yeah.

Well, I played with the, Maxie. Oh. Max had the, no dad had the, cause you know, the our band, Earl Crumb, and Monk Smith, Benji White, you know, Jelpy, all of them had bands. Well, they sold a band, and Mike had a beautiful tone, this last one. He was a musician, see? Had a band, and you got him playing in the band with him, George Beers. And man, we played that one night. He told everybody to wear what? Tuxedo. Man, you know, white colors. He was freezing cold. And George had to meet the artist. They used to…
We got out there, and Mac had a tuxedo all right, but with his overcoat, you know what I'm saying.
